why: A catalog's entries arrive in bulk from the catalog's source (a pull, an import), thousands at a time; they are reference data the catalog carries, and the catalog itself is the record the person made (catalog_created).
A line inside a purchase order, made and removed as part of editing the order; the order is the record (order_created) and its lines travel with it.
